Record Class RequestCondition.Body<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.RequestCondition.Body<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type
Record Components:
type - The type the body is read as
condition - Whether the body meets the condition, as a stage, which must not block: a synchronous predicate, see RequestCondition.body(Class, Predicate), is a completed stage
maxBytes - The limit of the body, or SERVER_LIMIT for the limit of the server
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestCondition
Enclosing interface:
RequestCondition
public static record RequestCondition.Body<T>(Argument<T> type, Function<? super T, ? extends CompletionStage<Boolean>> condition, int maxBytes) extends Record implements RequestCondition
A request whose body, read as the type, meets the condition: the body as text for String, as bytes for byte[], and otherwise decoded by the message body readers of its content type, like a @Body argument.

The router matches a request without its body, and leaves the routes whose body conditions decide the match pending. The server reads the body once, without blocking, from a copy, so the chosen route still reads the body in any way, evaluates the body conditions, and chooses among the routes whose body conditions the body meets. A request whose body meets the conditions of none of its best routes falls through to the next routes, and two equally good routes whose conditions the body both meets make the request ambiguous.

The body is held in memory, up to micronaut.server.max-request-buffer-size, or up to the lower limit of maxBytes(int): a larger body does not meet the condition. A limit lowers the limit of the server and cannot raise it: a route with a condition whose limit is above it fails the startup of the server.

Since:
5.3.0

Denis Stepanov
